notes.title: 20231220 update instructions
notes.notes:
1. The equipment store has added a batch sales function, which can sell all weapons and armors (excluding accessories) of the specified enchantment level and equipment star level in large quantities at one time.
2. In the professional function interface of the main menu, the skills of each profession are newly displayed.
3. During battle, you can directly press Shift to clear the currently used skill names on Clear's head to facilitate recombination of skills.

notes.title: 20231217 update instructions
notes.notes:
Recent update projects are as follows:
1. The all-out raid function has been changed to allow you to obtain money and drop props and equipment.
2. Added instructions for the first combination of skills during battle.
3. The initial weapon "Cracked Wooden Stick" has been changed to be able to use all types of skills, so that initial players can experience the skills of various professions.
4. Added shortcut keys "+" and "-" during combat to increase or decrease combat speed instantly.
5. The Demon Abyss increases the negative effects of "environmental demons".
6. Corrected that when the physical invalidation, magic invalidation, and invincibility spells take effect, there will no longer be -1 drop of blood, but -0 drop of blood, and therefore the enchantment effect of damage will no longer be triggered.
7. Physical invalidation, magic invalidation, physical rebound, magic rebound, invincibility, and absolute defense are changed to repeatable stacking effects.
8. Corrected the problem that the physical invalidation, magic invalidating, and invincibility spells are offset by the number of attacks instead of the number of actions as expected.
9. After using food-type props, the "full" state will be added. You cannot eat again until this state disappears.
10. Adjust the effect of disappearing. After use, the speed will return to 0, and the effect will be changed to +100% physical and magic evasion rate. When the enemy's hit rate exceeds 100%, there is still a chance to hit.
11. Adjust the effect of the enchantment "Magic Rat" so that the effect will only be triggered when the damage received reaches more than 10% of the maximum HP.
12. Increase the probability of winning in casino "slot games".
13. Fixed several bugs.

notes.title: 20231114 update instructions
notes.notes:
Recent update projects are as follows:
1. Add a shortcut key setting skill button at the bottom of the screen during battle, so that players can quickly activate skills by clicking with the mouse.
2. In the interfaces where you can see the equipment list in the prop window, equipment window, shop sales window, etc., you can press shift to switch the equipment sorting. It will be switched to the order of acquisition, equipment type, and enchantment type for sorting.
3. Modify the Challenge Achievement and Lone Wolf Achievement. As long as you obtain the STEAM achievement, you will get the achievement rewards and equipment at the beginning of the game when you restart the new game (the enchantments will be removed), allowing you to complete these two most difficult achievements. Get greater rewards.
4. Added the ability to directly switch to the player to give instructions when clicking on a player with the mouse.
5. When selecting an enemy target, press right or left continuously to select enemies in a cycle.
6. The option "Skip spell animations" in the options is changed to "Skip combat animations". When turned on, all skill animations in combat will be skipped.
7. Adjust the enchantment "Megaira's" to increase the upper limit of rebound damage to 9999.
8. Adjust the pet shop job game so that poop will no longer overlap.
9. Adjusting the enemy strength in "Bahamut Adventure" will not change depending on the game difficulty selected.
10.Add support for STEAM shortcut key function
11. Fixed several bugs.

notes.title: The trial version has been officially released for download
notes.notes:
Bahamut2-Come on,Fight! The trial version has been officially released for download. Players who are interested in this game can click "Download Trial Version" on the right side of the store page to try it out!
Bahamut2-Come on,Fight! The official version is expected to be officially launched on November 1st.
